text:
Kaitlyn: Anyone else seeing high 95th latency + failed allocations on eu-west-gpu this morning? Node churn + >10% allocation errors.
Ravi: yup. noticed a weird pattern — many tiny contexts evicting ks caches. logs show frequent OOM in slab allocator.
Meena: Is this the KV cache blowup again or something new?
Dmitri: Not KV this time. Prom query: sum(rate(gpu_memory_alloc_fail[5m])) by (node) shows spikes across 3 racks. I think there's fragmentation: small allocs can't fit even though free memory exists.
Kaitlyn: repro steps: schedule many short-lived jobs -> high alloc failures. attaching kernel dmesg snippet.
Kaitlyn: ```dmesg | tail -n50
[12345.678] tmm: slab_alloc failed: order=3, node=2
[12345.679] gpu-mgr: alloc_chunk failed size=32KB
```
Jorge: That fits slab fragmentation. Workaround we used on prod before: enable compact-gpu-scheduling and limit per-tenant small-burst jobs. Can flip via `/opt/scheduler/bin/schedule --policy compact` but requires draining nodes.
Ravi: Draining 10 nodes in eu-west now to apply patch. ETA 12m. Not ideal for latency-sensitive tenants.
infra-bot: Warning: rolling-drain starting on pool-eu-west-gpu-1 by @Ravi — expected capacity drop 8%.
Meena: Can we short-circuit by routing small sessions to dedicated tiny-pool instead of draining? Might be faster and cheaper than full drain.
Dmitri: tiny-pool has only 4 GPUs in eu-west, will saturate. But we can route non-SLA dev tenants there temporarily. Suggest route rule:
Dmitri: ```yaml
routes:
 - match: tenant.tags: dev
   dest: pool:eu-west-gpu-tiny
   max_burst: 20
```
Kaitlyn: Agree. Also we should add a preemptive script to consolidate allocations `consolidate-slab.sh` on nodes older than 72h.
Jorge: Cost note: using dedicated tiny-pool fallback for 3 hours ≈ $2.4k extra. Ops OK with that?
Meena: 👍 allocate from emergency budget. We need a postmortem and longer fix (kernel slab tune + scheduler compact mode as default).
Kaitlyn: After drain+patch applied; watch metrics please: grafana link http://grafana.company/d/aw3e/eu-west-gpu?orgId=1
Ravi: patch applied on 6 nodes, observing drop in alloc_fail in last 2m.
infra-bot: Info: node/rg-3dr-12 back to Ready.
Dmitri: Happy path looks green. I'll open a follow-up ticket to add `compact` flag behind a rollout feature flag and tests.
Meena: cc @security-team about any impact to tenant isolation from the routing change.
Kaitlyn: Thanks all. We'll post a short note to #incidents after confirmation. :thumbsup:
